    "os_target": "Windows operating system application layer and execution-time system call interface",
    "llm_role": "learns behavioral patterns from system calls and captures semantic relationships between normal and malicious behavior",
    "security_task": "malware detection",
    "evidence": "we propose a large language model (LLM) based framework for detecting malware at the application layer of the Windows operating system. By learning behavioral patterns from system calls triggered during program execution, the proposed framework allows the LLM to capture the semantic relationships between normal and malicious behaviors.",
    "suggested": "possible_core",
    "uncertainty": "Abstract does not specify which Windows interfaces or system calls are used or how the prototype was evaluated; the OS dimension rests on the stated application layer and system-call behavior."
